ScoringDimensions.Facts: Source-linked semantic review of dialogue, option premises and proposed metadata; whole-reply grounding is a required criterion. Any failed criterion fails the reply; uncertainty remains separate.
ScoringDimensions.PythonFormat: Recorded Python envelope and line-layout inspection; it is not production parser validation.
ScoringDimensions.ProductionParser: Separate offline validation joined to replies by request, prompt and reply hashes. Body, strict inline metadata and strict pipeline results remain distinct.
ScoringDimensions.MetadataContract: Counts and observations of recall-time memory proposals are separate from factual correctness. Proposals were not executed or persisted to game saves.

ReviewMethod.Kind: Model-assisted semantic review; no independent human sign-off or automatic judge call is claimed.
ReviewMethod.PublishedFields: Hashes, counts, case/criterion identifiers, verdicts and concise limitations only; no raw prompts, replies, evidence quotes, provider addresses or credentials.

Limitations: These are development cases used to find failures and tune prompts, not an independent held-out evaluation.
Each variant has one provider sample per scenario. Do not infer general accuracy, statistical improvement or all-model behavior.
Round one preserves its initial fixture and rubric; rounds two through five use a changed fixture. Prompts and assembly snapshots also differ between rounds.
No pooled factual accuracy is calculated across these rounds. Only the initial baseline/candidate run is a paired comparison with identical fixture and asset bytes.
Semantic judgments can depend on whether wording asserts an event or merely expresses a current attitude; unresolved interpretations remain uncertain.
Quoted evidence retention and budget checks are capture diagnostics, not evidence that the model answered correctly.
Parser acceptance does not establish factual accuracy, renderer behavior, runtime action authorization or end-to-end in-game acceptance.
Offline parser validation made no network calls, invoked no classifier fallback and executed no game actions.
Historical assembly hashes identify recorded experiments and must not be presented as validation of later code changes.
The final positive controls establish two valid metadata proposals while retaining one whole-reply failure. No game save was written and no end-to-end game acceptance was performed.
Final delivery retains observed hallucinations, semantic drift and review uncertainty rather than further tuning prompts to these same samples.

FinalVerification.Scope: Final isolated source snapshot and offline regression, distinct from the five historical live rounds and the two final positive controls.
Limitations: Input equivalence for these 11 scenarios is not a rerun of their historical provider requests against the final assembly, nor proof of all runtime behavior.
History hardening without an explicit revision cue conservatively omits an older assertion only for multiple shared terms and an oversized later complete entry; it is not a semantic state parser.
The full isolated regression passes while known provider hallucinations and semantic drift remain documented. No game end-to-end acceptance is claimed.
